evidence_items.finding: revenue has been flat at approximately $380K for three consecutive years despite the owner working 60+ hours per week
evidence_items.rationale: Three-year revenue plateau with owner working 60+ hours is a critical adverse operational capacity signal. operational_efficiency; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: production facility operates at near-full capacity three days per week and sits idle waiting for materials for the remaining two days
evidence_items.rationale: Two days per week of production idle time due to materials availability is a critical adverse throughput signal. operational_efficiency; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: only the owner understands and operates the production scheduling system — no other staff member has been trained on it
evidence_items.rationale: Single-person scheduling system dependency is a critical adverse process maturity signal. process_maturity; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the owner approves every quote, handles every client call, and signs off on every design before production
evidence_items.rationale: Owner involvement in every approval is an adverse throughput signal but not the primary throughput constraint given the materials idle time. operational_efficiency.

evidence_items.finding: signage fabrication; $380K revenue for 3 years; 60+ hour owner week; 3 days at capacity, 2 days idle waiting materials; scheduling system: owner only; 5 staff
Surface signal (not root cause): owner working 60+ hours with approval authority over every quote, client interaction, and design decision is the textbook owner capacity ceiling
evidence_items.rationale: Owner time saturation is the primary misleading signal — it directs attention to delegation as the intervention when production idle time indicates the throughput constraint is in materials scheduling, not approvals.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): three-year revenue plateau at the same level is most intuitively explained by the owner having hit a personal time limit
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue plateau attributed to owner time is a misleading causal signal — the two-day materials idle time independently caps throughput regardless of owner time available.

validation_notes: SIM-13-008 is SUPPORTED via operational_bottleneck. Materials procurement constraint as throughput bottleneck independent of owner time maps to operational bottleneck. No must_identify vocabulary.
